Chi_Notification_Rules_Description: Rules that decide what is allowed to interrupt you. Ask Chi in plain language — for example "only interrupt me for the Hernandez matter" or "nothing after 7pm unless it's from a partner" — and the rule is saved here so you can always see exactly what is being filtered.
Chi_Notification_Rules_Empty: You have no smart notification rules yet. Direct mentions and direct messages always interrupt you; everything else collects into your digest.
Chi_Notification_Rules_Defaults: A direct mention or a direct message always interrupts you — only a rule you write yourself that says "silence" can stop that. Everything else with no matching rule collects into your digest.
Chi_Notification_Rules_Limit_Reached: You have reached the maximum of __max__ notification rules. Remove one before adding another.
Chi_Notification_Rules_Precedence: When several rules match the same message, the most specific one wins.
Chi_Notification_Rules_Clear_Confirm: Delete all of your smart notification rules and go back to the defaults? This cannot be undone.
Chi_Notification_Rule_Action_Digest_Desc: Do not interrupt me; collect it for my digest.
Chi_Notification_Rule_Action_Silence_Des: Never surface it, even if I am mentioned.
Chi_Notification_Rule_Include_Mentions: Apply even when I am mentioned directly
